title: Kessler Status, 10:45: 1,463 Registered, Generator Fuel Under 40%

fields.facility: Emergency Operations Center, Campus Services Building room 108
fields.title: Mass Care & Fuel Status
fields.preparedBy: Kessler registration desk / EOC Facilities desk

resources.name: Kessler Fieldhouse shelter — headcount
resources.notes: OPEN. Registered: 1,463 of 1,800. Arrivals about 40 per 10 min (Sugar Run Apartments, Lot C commuters, Lower Quad buildings). Count passes 1,500 near 10:50.
resources.owner: Dean of Students / Kessler registration desk

resources.name: Kessler Fieldhouse — cots
resources.notes: LOW. Cots set: 1,200 for 1,463 registered. 263 registrants without a cot.

resources.name: Kessler generator — day tank
resources.notes: Under 40%. 36-hour run time assumed a full tank. No delivery possible on the current route. Burn rate still to be confirmed.

resources.name: Diesel tanker (08:00 delivery)
resources.notes: Loaded and holding on the far side of the Dairy Lane crossing. Driver is waiting for a destination and route.

resources.name: Dairy Lane crossing
resources.notes: CLOSED and submerged since 08:04. Mill Street gauge 10.81 ft at 10:32, trend steady. Marlowe Fire on its alternate route.

resources.name: Lower Quad service drive (plant yard access)
resources.notes: Under water. The only other way into the plant yard is blocked.

resources.name: Student Union ballroom (alternate shelter, 400)
resources.notes: NOT AVAILABLE. Regional nursing career fair in progress, 30 vendor tables set. Needs a cancellation by someone with authority. At least 45 min to clear the tables.

resources.name: Kessler generator-backed outlets
resources.notes: LOW. North wall by the training room: 2 used by the oxygen concentrator users, 1 charging station. No spare outlets.

resources.name: Communication access — interpreter
resources.notes: Requested, not on site. Deaf Riverside resident is registered at Kessler. Announcements are by PA only.

resources.name: Kessler drinking water
resources.notes: OK.

resources.name: Central plant fuel (Dairy Lane)
resources.notes: 3 days on site. Plant above flood level at the current stage. Chilled water and steam normal to 14 buildings.

instructorNote: This tests mass-care capacity and fuel. Watch whether the Dean of Students opens the Student Union ballroom and has the fair cancelled before Kessler passes 1,500. The oxygen users and the deaf student must stay in the general shelter with their supports, and Facilities and Campus Police should agree on an upland route with an escort, or a small vehicle delivery, using a fuel plan built on hours remaining. Note any seat that waits for Dairy Lane to reopen.
